target.platform_from_firmware: ARM EABI5, HiSilicon SD56xx/SD5610x family, Linux 2.6.30

ranking.name: OEM userspace deployment
ranking.summary: Best eventual preservation path: add isolated manually started userspace processes on the OEM kernel while retaining Huawei hardware/network services.
ranking.primary_blocker: No authorized shell method for this exact unit; no target run; V1.2 is only a monitor scaffold.

ranking.name: USB-based deployment
ranking.summary: FTP staging is confirmed; USB-to-/tmp extraction is the leading conditional experiment once shell access and tmpfs flags are verified.
ranking.primary_blocker: No shell access, live USB mapping/filesystem options, or live /tmp execution verification.

ranking.name: OEM RootFS integration
ranking.summary: A historical additive OEM RootFS candidate fits the fixed span while retaining OEM content; startup and target boot remain unproven.
ranking.primary_blocker: No supported one-shot init or mic extension point, no authenticated update contract, no recovery or target boot.

ranking.name: Modified firmware image
ranking.summary: Host builders can assemble a same-size container preserving the original kernel bytes; this does not prove updater acceptance or hardware function.
ranking.primary_blocker: Unknown package authentication, MTD/boot mapping, exact boot protocol, recovery and target validation.

ranking.name: Existing third-party firmware
ranking.summary: Public OpenWrt HG630 support refers to Broadcom/MIPS variants; no exact ARM/SD5610x HG630 V2 VER.B DSL-capable image found.
ranking.primary_blocker: No exact board support, image, DSL/Wi-Fi stack, boot adaptation or verified recovery.

options.name: Telnet
options.detail: insmod_all.sh requests atpsync dynapp telnetd true; runtime effect/live state unknown, telnetd passwd shell is /bin/false

options.name: UART/service console
options.detail: Respawn shell and ttyAMA nodes do not identify board pads, levels, tty binding, authentication, or approved procedure.

options.name: mic/dynamic app
options.detail: OEM manager starts after platform setup; no supported custom-app registration interface established.

options.name: Admin web/maintenance shell
options.detail: Typed upload/storage flows and internal diagnostics do not establish a supported remote shell.

A.oem_userspace_result: Plausible as shared-kernel userspace; requires authorized shell, target storage checks and target service tests.
A.isolation: No container boundary proven; processes share OEM kernel, global network stack and devices.
A.current_openlinux_payload: V1.2 monitor scaffold only; NETWORK_MODE disabled; no OpenLinux network service payload.

blocked_gates: outer checksum/signature coverage and legitimate key
physical flash geometry and partition map
exact boot args/handoff and target RootFS mount
full backup and tested independent recovery
DSL/Ethernet/Wi-Fi/calibration validation on identical test hardware

recommended_route.near_term: Authorized OEM shell -> read-only target inventory -> FTP-stage unchanged V1.2 archive on USB -> verify /tmp tmpfs is executable/writable/sufficient -> extract into new /tmp directory -> run only network-disabled monitor manually -> inspect logs/status -> stop/uninstall.
recommended_route.persistent_later: Only after recovery/update gates: additive RootFS integration preserving OEM kernel, vendor stack and data, tested first on a spare identical unit.
recommended_route.next_operator_action: Obtain a documented authorized shell/service-console procedure and exact VER.B board details from Huawei or an authorized service provider.
